QuestInfo.name: [Verne Mine] I Can't Escape
QuestInfo.0: You went outside with #p2154005#, but you don't know if he fell for your trick. Talk to #b#p2154005##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2154004#, who was supposed to escape while you keep #p2154005# busy, has not escaped yet. There must be some reason that's stopping her... Ask #b#p2154004##k.
QuestInfo.2: If #p2154004# escaped, the Black Wings would take revenge on the entire town. #p2154004# decided to stay back, so that the Black Wings wouldn't hurt the town.

0.0: What? Its the same as always! You must have misjudged the Big Boulder Muncher's movements. Stupid human. I guess not all humans are smart.
0.1: Never mind that! I have to worry about my mission. My mission is to keep my eyes on #p2154004#. It's not like she can escape, but a job's a job. I'm going inside!

1.0: ...\r\n#L0##bWhy didn't you flee? Didn't #p2153003# tell you to run away?#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, you are the person who helped #p2153003# get here? Thank you for helping #p2153003#. But I can't run away.

yes.0: Our town is under the control of the Black Wings. If I were to run away, I suppose things would be better for me...but not for Edelstein. The Black Wings would try to exact vengeance.
yes.1: So, you see, I can't leave this place. But don't worry. One day, we'll overcome the Black Wings. I just have to be patient and wait for that day.

npc.0: #b#p2154004##k is safe. Although, I suppose she couldn't have run away in such a short time anyway?
